title: ODCSImportReport
description: What importing an ODCS document into OpenMetadata keeps, changes and leaves out, so the user can decide whether to import it.

odcsImportIssueSeverity.description: `blocking` issues prevent the import; `warning` issues mean part of the document will not be imported, or not as written; `info` issues describe how something is imported.

odcsImportIssueCategory.description: Part of the ODCS document an issue is about.

odcsImportIssue.description: One finding about the ODCS document. Findings about the same key in many places, e.g. `businessName` on every property, are reported once with the number of occurrences.

field.description: ODCS key the finding is about, e.g. `businessName`.

path.description: Location of the first occurrence in the document, e.g. `schema[0].properties[3].businessName`.

occurrences.description: Number of places in the document the finding applies to.

message.description: What happens to the field and why.

odcsQualityRuleOutcome.description: What one ODCS quality rule becomes in OpenMetadata.

name.description: Name of the rule in the ODCS document.

column.description: Column the rule is attached to, if any.

outcome.description: `testCase`: the rule runs as a test case. `sla`: the rule sets the contract's refresh frequency. `notExecuted`: the rule is kept with the contract but nothing runs it.

testDefinition.description: Test definition the rule runs as, for `testCase` outcomes.

testCaseName.description: Name of the test case the rule creates or updates, for `testCase` outcomes.

reason.description: Why the rule is not executed, for `notExecuted` outcomes.

canImport.description: False when at least one issue is blocking.

canCreateTestCases.description: Whether the requesting user may create test cases on the target, which importing quality rules as test cases requires.
